title: Single-forward multi-Mirror functional output transport
hypothesis: At heldout useful task quality and matched actual serialized bytes, 4/5 trained logical Experts can be reconstructed from one cached statistic at <=0.90 P95 compared with strongest admissible byte-near non-Mirror method.
mirror_coordinate: per-role output or hidden m; f_m(x)=g_m(r(x)) only if fiber invariance
success_gate: 4/5 fresh task identities within +0.02 nat/token NLL and >=10% actual total bytes savings and <=0.90x P95 of fastest same-quality strong native baseline; extra simple code must not dominate.
failure_gate: Exact output transport fails for hidden nonlinear tasks or ordinary output head / pre-folded control dominates at feasible RAM.
uncertainty: metric u_c covariance aware, k=2 indicative only; runtime clock in seconds and serialized bytes measured separately
hardware: CPU mechanism tested; real CPU/GPU natural task evaluation pending
